# smartrecruiters fixtures

Real response from a public, unauthenticated endpoint (one request, User-Agent
`RumoJobSearch/0.1.0 (uso pessoal)`), captured on 2026-11-14.

- URL: https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/smartrecruiters/postings?limit=5 (smartrecruiters.json) and the `ref` of the first item (posting_detail.json)
- file(s): smartrecruiters.json, posting_detail.json
- original size: 1,824 bytes (first file)
- original items: 1 posting (totalFound 1)
- kept: all (not trimmed); posting_detail.json is the single detail request, 8,278 bytes

Trimming: only the list was cut; item objects are unmodified (re-serialised as
indented UTF-8 JSON). E-mail addresses would be replaced by `removido@example.test`
(none were present). No personal data of candidates.
